text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout id=canary-2026-03-21-18 flagged: p95 latency > 500ms in us-west-2 for 6m. Suggested action: hold traffic split. auto-rollback = OFF (safety_valve counts = 2). link: https://telemetry/redwood/canary-2026-03-21-18
Maya: saw it, pulling frontend traces and kernel queue logs. ETA 7m.
AJ: +1 hold. curious why auto-rollback didn\u2019t flip — can someone paste the rule set?
deploy-bot: Auto-rollback rules: requires >=3 infra alerts OR >= 10% error-rise OR safety_valve=true + sustained latency. Current state: 2 infra alerts (kv-cache, kernel-queue), error rate +0.6%. No auto-revert.
Sophie: this meets human-review threshold. recommend manual pin to v2.5.6 for hosted rollout, keep dedicated unchanged. OpsOnCall can you prep customer comms and SLA note if we pin?
OpsOnCall: on it. Drafting now and will notify #customer-ops. ETA 10m. Do we need a maintenance window?
Lee: no maintenance window required; traffic will be routed back to stable variant. Degradation only, no requests dropped. Recommend avoid auto re-release until RCA.
AJ: I'll run a targeted bisect on the canary shard that introduced the kernel flag. If we pin, what's the admin pin command?
Maya: pin command (internal):
```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/releases/pin \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"version":"2.5.6","scope":"hosted","reason":"canary_latency_regression_1768510501"}'
```
AJ: standing by to execute once we confirm the smoke results.
Sophie: OpsOnCall, include in comms: 1) symptom (canary p95 spike), 2) action (hold rollout and pin to stable), 3) ETA for update (30m), 4) customer impact (potential slow responses).
OpsOnCall: ack — posting to customers and adding incident link.
deploy-bot: Action: traffic split hold applied to canary-2026-03-21-18. AuditID=rbk-def456. No auto-rollback executed.
Maya: quick smoke runs against v2.5.6 show stable kernel and normal queue depths. Ready for prod pin.
AJ: executed pin for hosted. Confirmed hosted routing back to 2.5.6; canary paused.
Sophie: we'll keep canary paused for 2 hours, then attempt a constrained re-rollout at 5% if telemetry is green. Add to release notes: "Host rollout paused due to p95 regression; reverted to 2.5.6. Investigation ongoing."
Nora: product team notified and preparing customer-facing blurb for high-touch accounts.
Lee: opening follow-up ticket INFRA-4722: investigate kernel-queue backpressure and KV cache TTL interactions. Assigning to infra.
OpsOnCall: customer comms posted: "We observed increased latency during a canary rollout and temporarily resumed the previous stable version while we investigate. No data loss. Updates within 30 minutes." :thumbsup:
Sophie: Postmortem checklist: owner (Maya), timeline, snapshots of telemetry, root cause hypothesis, decision on enabling auto-rollback for this rule set.
Maya: I'll own the postmortem and start timeline capture now.
AJ: adding runbook note: pin via console requires oncall approval unless auto-rollback triggers.
deploy-bot: Summary: canary held, hosted pinned to 2.5.6, incident ticket INFRA-4722 created, customer comms sent.
Sophie: moving conversation to #release-handoffs for follow-up ops sync. :pray:
